metadata.title: Romantic Soundtrack Layout with Tri-Panel Composition

retrievalProfile.description: A three-tier vertical stack featuring a central typographic band separating a soft interior portrait from a warm outdoor romantic scene.
triggerTerms: central text band with split imagery
excludeWhen: gritty or dark aesthetic is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically stacked composition divided into three distinct horizontal sections: a top portrait in a soft-lit interior, a middle white band containing clean sans-serif typography, and a bottom wide-angle romantic scene set against a sunset cityscape.
coreVisualRelationships: The central white band acts as a structural anchor and visual separator.
The top and bottom images share a warm, golden-hour color temperature.
The subjects in the bottom panel are positioned to create a central focal point directly beneath the main title.
The typography uses color-coding to link specific words to the visual themes of the imagery.
coreInvariants: High-key white background for the text section
Warm, diffused lighting in both photographic panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Top panel features a medium close-up centered portrait; bottom panel features a medium shot of a couple in profile, centered and facing each other.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, two-tone title in the central white band.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan starting from the portrait, through the title, to the emotional climax in the bottom scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the middle horizontal band to provide maximum legibility for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals and soft whites in the backgrounds.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue and dusty rose for typography and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-hour sunlight and city lights in the bottom panel.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with moderate saturation to maintain a soft, romantic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to soft blues, pinks, and warm ambers

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the primary title features a small speech bubble tail integrated into the lower-left curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights, colors, and tracking to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Speech bubble icon integrated into letterform

preserve: Two-tone color split in main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure and professional weight distribution.
Provides a similar open feel and geometric 'O' shapes.
Classic geometric choice for clean, uppercase display work.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-part vertical stack. Top: A soft-lit indoor portrait of a woman in a dark turtleneck. Middle: A solid white horizontal band. Bottom: A romantic couple in profile against a golden-hour city skyline with a suspension bridge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the middle white band, center a large two-word title in a bold geometric sans-serif. Use a muted blue for the first word and a dusty pink for the second. Add smaller, wide-tracked blue text above and below the title.

verificationChecks: Is the composition divided into three clear horizontal sections?
Is the central band pure white with no background imagery?
Does the main title use two different colors?
Is the typography a clean, uppercase sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific city in the bottom background
Width of the central white band
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the actors
Any studio or production company logos

mustAchieve: Legible, high-contrast typography in the center
Consistent warm lighting across both photos
avoid: Inconsistent color grading between the two images

postGenerationChecks: Verify the central band is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the text is centered both vertically and horizontally within the white band.
Check that the 'O' in the title has a subtle graphic modification.
Confirm the bottom image features a sunset/golden hour palette.
Ensure no text overlaps the photographic sections.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tri-panel stack [Top: Portrait] + [Middle: White band with bold 2-color sans-serif] + [Bottom: Scenic romantic wide shot].
